elements.name: one man alone seen from behind, hips up
both hands on flat top of low balcony wall
wide city view of Addis Ababa
old worn olive green canvas backpack on top of the wall beside him
dark brown skin, short black curly hair, plain shirt

anatomy: The right arm passes behind the backpack and the hand reappears far to the right on the wall, which makes the arm look overly long and hard to read.
notes: Make the small red-and-white sign on the building just above the backpack a plain blank shape, and move the backpack slightly so the right hand sits naturally on the wall near his body and is clearly visible.
